# The VT parser's transition table, transcribed from Ghostty's
# src/terminal/parse_table.zig (genTable) at commit cf3a8a6594ee, one line
# per call of single or range, in the order the source makes them. A later
# line overrides an earlier one for the same state and byte, and a pair no
# line sets stays in its state with the action none, as genTable's final
# loop does. "anywhere" stands for the loop over every state.
#
#   single BYTE FROM TO ACTION
#   range  LOW HIGH FROM TO ACTION      (both bytes included)
#
# The law StepMatchesTable (ghostty/table.ergo) holds the parser's step to this
# table for every state and every byte.
#
# Ghostty's notice, which covers the transcribed table:
#
# MIT License
#
# Copyright (c) 2024 Mitchell Hashimoto, Ghostty contributors
#
# Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
# of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal
# in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights
# to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell
# copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is
# furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:
#
# The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all
# copies or substantial portions of the Software.
#
# THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
# IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
# FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
# AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
# LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
# OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
# SOFTWARE.

# anywhere => ground
single 0x18 anywhere ground execute
single 0x1A anywhere ground execute
range 0x80 0x8F anywhere ground execute
range 0x91 0x97 anywhere ground execute
single 0x99 anywhere ground execute
single 0x9A anywhere ground execute
single 0x9C anywhere ground none
# anywhere => escape
single 0x1B anywhere escape none
# anywhere => sos_pm_apc_string
single 0x98 anywhere sos_pm_apc_string none
single 0x9E anywhere sos_pm_apc_string none
single 0x9F anywhere sos_pm_apc_string none
# anywhere => csi_entry
single 0x9B anywhere csi_entry none
# anywhere => dcs_entry
single 0x90 anywhere dcs_entry none
# anywhere => osc_string
single 0x9D anywhere osc_string none

# ground
single 0x19 ground ground execute
range 0x00 0x17 ground ground execute
range 0x1C 0x1F ground ground execute
range 0x20 0x7F ground ground print

# escape_intermediate
single 0x19 escape_intermediate escape_intermediate execute
range 0x00 0x17 escape_intermediate escape_intermediate execute
range 0x1C 0x1F escape_intermediate escape_intermediate execute
range 0x20 0x2F escape_intermediate escape_intermediate collect
single 0x7F escape_intermediate escape_intermediate ignore
range 0x30 0x7E escape_intermediate ground esc_dispatch

# sos_pm_apc_string
single 0x19 sos_pm_apc_string sos_pm_apc_string apc_put
range 0x00 0x17 sos_pm_apc_string sos_pm_apc_string apc_put
range 0x1C 0x1F sos_pm_apc_string sos_pm_apc_string apc_put
range 0x20 0x7F sos_pm_apc_string sos_pm_apc_string apc_put

# escape
single 0x19 escape escape execute
range 0x00 0x17 escape escape execute
range 0x1C 0x1F escape escape execute
single 0x7F escape escape ignore
range 0x30 0x4F escape ground esc_dispatch
range 0x51 0x57 escape ground esc_dispatch
range 0x60 0x7E escape ground esc_dispatch
single 0x59 escape ground esc_dispatch
single 0x5A escape ground esc_dispatch
single 0x5C escape ground esc_dispatch
range 0x20 0x2F escape escape_intermediate collect
single 0x58 escape sos_pm_apc_string none
single 0x5E escape sos_pm_apc_string none
single 0x5F escape sos_pm_apc_string none
single 0x50 escape dcs_entry none
single 0x5B escape csi_entry none
single 0x5D escape osc_string none

# dcs_entry
single 0x19 dcs_entry dcs_entry ignore
range 0x00 0x17 dcs_entry dcs_entry ignore
range 0x1C 0x1F dcs_entry dcs_entry ignore
single 0x7F dcs_entry dcs_entry ignore
range 0x20 0x2F dcs_entry dcs_intermediate collect
single 0x3A dcs_entry dcs_ignore none
range 0x30 0x39 dcs_entry dcs_param param
single 0x3B dcs_entry dcs_param param
range 0x3C 0x3F dcs_entry dcs_param collect
range 0x40 0x7E dcs_entry dcs_passthrough none

# dcs_intermediate
single 0x19 dcs_intermediate dcs_intermediate ignore
range 0x00 0x17 dcs_intermediate dcs_intermediate ignore
range 0x1C 0x1F dcs_intermediate dcs_intermediate ignore
range 0x20 0x2F dcs_intermediate dcs_intermediate collect
single 0x7F dcs_intermediate dcs_intermediate ignore
range 0x30 0x3F dcs_intermediate dcs_ignore none
range 0x40 0x7E dcs_intermediate dcs_passthrough none

# dcs_ignore
single 0x19 dcs_ignore dcs_ignore ignore
range 0x00 0x17 dcs_ignore dcs_ignore ignore
range 0x1C 0x1F dcs_ignore dcs_ignore ignore
range 0x80 0xFF dcs_ignore dcs_ignore ignore

# dcs_param
single 0x19 dcs_param dcs_param ignore
range 0x00 0x17 dcs_param dcs_param ignore
range 0x1C 0x1F dcs_param dcs_param ignore
range 0x30 0x39 dcs_param dcs_param param
single 0x3B dcs_param dcs_param param
single 0x7F dcs_param dcs_param ignore
single 0x3A dcs_param dcs_ignore none
range 0x3C 0x3F dcs_param dcs_ignore none
range 0x20 0x2F dcs_param dcs_intermediate collect
range 0x40 0x7E dcs_param dcs_passthrough none

# dcs_passthrough
single 0x19 dcs_passthrough dcs_passthrough put
range 0x00 0x17 dcs_passthrough dcs_passthrough put
range 0x1C 0x1F dcs_passthrough dcs_passthrough put
range 0x20 0x7E dcs_passthrough dcs_passthrough put
single 0x7F dcs_passthrough dcs_passthrough ignore
range 0x80 0xFF dcs_passthrough dcs_passthrough put

# csi_param
single 0x19 csi_param csi_param execute
range 0x00 0x17 csi_param csi_param execute
range 0x1C 0x1F csi_param csi_param execute
range 0x30 0x39 csi_param csi_param param
single 0x3A csi_param csi_param param
single 0x3B csi_param csi_param param
single 0x7F csi_param csi_param ignore
range 0x40 0x7E csi_param ground csi_dispatch
range 0x3C 0x3F csi_param csi_ignore none
range 0x20 0x2F csi_param csi_intermediate collect

# csi_ignore
single 0x19 csi_ignore csi_ignore execute
range 0x00 0x17 csi_ignore csi_ignore execute
range 0x1C 0x1F csi_ignore csi_ignore execute
range 0x20 0x3F csi_ignore csi_ignore ignore
single 0x7F csi_ignore csi_ignore ignore
range 0x40 0x7E csi_ignore ground none

# csi_intermediate
single 0x19 csi_intermediate csi_intermediate execute
range 0x00 0x17 csi_intermediate csi_intermediate execute
range 0x1C 0x1F csi_intermediate csi_intermediate execute
range 0x20 0x2F csi_intermediate csi_intermediate collect
single 0x7F csi_intermediate csi_intermediate ignore
range 0x40 0x7E csi_intermediate ground csi_dispatch
range 0x30 0x3F csi_intermediate csi_ignore none

# csi_entry
single 0x19 csi_entry csi_entry execute
range 0x00 0x17 csi_entry csi_entry execute
range 0x1C 0x1F csi_entry csi_entry execute
single 0x7F csi_entry csi_entry ignore
range 0x40 0x7E csi_entry ground csi_dispatch
single 0x3A csi_entry csi_ignore none
range 0x20 0x2F csi_entry csi_intermediate collect
range 0x30 0x39 csi_entry csi_param param
single 0x3B csi_entry csi_param param
range 0x3C 0x3F csi_entry csi_param collect

# osc_string
single 0x19 osc_string osc_string ignore
range 0x00 0x06 osc_string osc_string ignore
range 0x08 0x17 osc_string osc_string ignore
range 0x1C 0x1F osc_string osc_string ignore
range 0x20 0xFF osc_string osc_string osc_put
single 0x07 osc_string ground none
